description: Implementation of POSIX spinlock functions for Zephyr RTOS, including spinlock initialization, destruction, locking, try-locking, and unlocking, with internal management of spinlock pool and bitarray.

methods.name: pthread_spin_init
methods.description: Initializes a pthread spinlock, allocating a spinlock from the pool and setting the lock variable.

methods.name: pthread_spin_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a pthread spinlock, freeing its slot in the pool.

methods.name: pthread_spin_lock
methods.description: Locks the specified spinlock, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: pthread_spin_trylock
methods.description: Attempts to lock the specified spinlock without blocking.
